newsitem.title: USA: SEC says comment due Nov 20 on MSRB price rule.
newsitem.headline: SEC says comment due Nov 20 on MSRB price rule.

text.p: The SEC requested comments by Nov. 20 on an MSRB proposal for broker-dealers to begin reporting prices and other information in connection with municipal bond trades with retail and institutional customers.

The draft amendments to the Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board's rule G-14 would launch a major new phase in the board's transaction reporting program, which is designed to improve price transparency in the muni market.

Dealers would report prices to the MSRB, which would make the information available to federal enforcement regulators like the Securities and Exchange Commission and National Association of Securities Dealers.
A copy of the rules appears in today's Federal Register.
Send comments to Secretary, SEC, 450 Fifth St., N.W., Washington, D.C. 20549. Refer to File No. SR-MSRB-96-10.
